profile.headline: Building new features @CE21
profile.summary:
I love building smart, maintainable software. 

At CE21 I research and build new features to keep our company ahead of the competition. I pride myself on making those features self contained, easily extendible, and ready for multiple use cases. 

In my free time I dabble in game dev / multi-agent AI with an eye towards simulating human behavior.  Feel free to reach out if you're also interested in economy simulations or MARL research!

positions.title: Research and Development Software Engineer
positions.description: Building new features for our Continuing Education clients to customize their online platforms.

positions.title: AI Research Assistant
positions.description: Using reinforcement learning in multi-agent environments

positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description: Using Azure Cognitive Search, I rebuilt CE21s in-house search solution to give better, faster results.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Helped lead the company in transforming their consulting business into an online membership site, requiring the creation of over 80 web pages and dozens of hours of video. The company still runs on this model and has had great success with it.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description: Served as regional leader for 6 months over 10 areas covering eastern Switzerland. Fluent in German/Swiss German. Happy to serve.
